stages: single-rank shared/unrolled forward and summed-gradient parity

reference_search.reference: S0, both families, 10B tokens, 20% decay endpoint
reference_search.method: coordinate refinement with best-of-search confirmation, not all combinations
reference_search.budget: 14 S0 runs plus 6 S1 LR-calibration runs at 10B tokens each

long_horizon_checks.use: estimate horizon trend before final ladder; expand if boundary wins, within contingency cap

recipes: remove medium-low; transfer 10 points to medium
remove synthetic; transfer 10 points to medium-high
data_screen.paired_data_manifest: same sampler seed and versioned pools; differing mixtures cannot have identical training text
data_screen.required_followup: confirm winning recipe versus baseline at S1 and target exposure

shape_and_expert_screen.budget: 8 S1-equivalent 20B-token runs; match actual compute, record parameter/cache mismatch

core_ladder.seed_cluster_unit: stable trunk and its decay branches

held_out.high_tpp: Both S1 families at 720B, new seed independent of fitting trunks; freeze fits and decisions before observing results. This is about 220–226 stored-parameter TPP for this tier.
held_out.hero_shape: selected 32-layer hero shape at 10B; standalone complete short-horizon WSD for size holdout and systems validation, not a 3.5T stability guarantee

hero_release_gate.paired_gain_confidence: 95% run-cluster bootstrap interval excludes no improvement
hero_release_gate.critical_task_floor: at most 1 absolute accuracy point regression, interpreted with evaluation uncertainty
hero_release_gate.budgeted_hero_tokens: freeze from measured sustained throughput before launch
